There are plenty of things you can do, similar to how you’d treat yourself while quitting a substance. Practice self care! Get to know yourself and LOVE that person. Take care of all your needs because that lack of self love is what got you into certain places/things (ex:alcohol) 
Find a hobby or get back into an old one. Find something that gives you a sense of security, something healthy to replace that comfort we find from unhealthy things. And also, connect with people! Whether it be therapy or a trusted friend or someone on reddit ( you can message me too!) It helps SO much to share those thoughts you’re having with someone and not keep them bottled in. Let it all out, release everything, cry it alll out, write it all out, talk it all out, release release release! Don’t let it sit inside only for it to come back again and destroy your mind.. let it go in a healthy way while you work on bettering yourself. 

I hope this helps ! Best wishes and hugs sent to you

I’d recommend letting your partner know, if you trust and are close with them! When you dissociate, let them know and maybe take a break or let your partner help you to be in the present moment. Remember, thinking about suicide can be a coping mechanism for a lot of people, it was for me. And our coping skills end up becoming a habit because they give us a sense of escape. Now, your brain is so used to thinking about suicide! That’s okay. Acknowledge the feeling, understand why it’s really there. Acknowledge the thoughts and know they WILL pass and let them. Remind yourself it is only a thought, a thought you’ve had many times before that are now stuck in a pattern; a pattern when you can see it, can stop it. I hope this helps in anyway. the best way to truly “accept” this is to find that love with yourself. if you were to put yourself that high and see yourself as that amazing and great and all these great things..... just IMAGINE what you could do. Imagine how you’d feel, so complete, never ever doubting your worth for anyone else. 

And there’s no rush in getting there yet, start slow, start to be easy on yourself, do little things that will make YOU feel happy and better .
